newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World airport body ACI appoints new chief.
newsitem.headline: World airport body ACI appoints new chief.

text.p: The world airports body ACI announced on Friday that it had appointed former U.S. aviation lawyer and industry expert Jonathan Howe as its new director-general.

The Geneva-based ACI -- Airports Council International -- links about 460 international airports and airport authorities in more than 150 countries around the globe. It holds its annual conference in Paris later this month.

Howe had a long career as a legal officer in the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) before serving 1986-91 as president of the National Business Aircraft Association (ABAA) which links major U.S. and multinational companies.

He will take over at ACI on September 15 from its current chief Oris Dunham, who was appointed director-general in 1991 after five years as executive director of Dallas-Fort Worth airport, a major U.S. hub.
